title: PowerGrid: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe PowerGrid loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Start with one generator, one storage block, one consumer, and a meter. Confirm power flow before adding machines or long cable runs.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: The first stable grid is tiny: generator, storage, one consumer, a meter, and proof that power flows before long cables or machines are added.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves PowerGrid is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: First Checkpoint
blocks.body: Use this as the first concrete checkpoint before the route gets wider.
